learning.why: Teacher's repeated emphasis on all three parts of health, plus this question specifically asking about someone not sick but not fully healthy, helped me connect that health is not just no fever.

end.summary: Practised health as physical, mental and social well-being.
end.parentNote: Siya practised identifying physical, mental and social health through examples about sleep, feelings, friendships and activity. They initially mixed up mental and social health, then corrected this by linking loneliness and not talking to friends with social health. At home, ask Siya to sort everyday examples into physical, mental or social health.
